messages:
mike: quick sync — noticed a perf regression after landing the kernel-selector changes on main. Llama-2-13B AWQ on p4d is ~18% slower on tail latency compared to yesterday. No infra changes except selector. Anyone else seeing this?

sara: yikes. can you paste the profiler output and the exact commit? also which batching config and autoscale were used?

mike: commit: 8f3a9c2 (kernel-selector v2). Batcher: default dynamic-batcher, max_batch=64, bin_by_length=true. Canary traffic on dedicated-pool-us-east-1. Profiler snippet:```
hot functions (ms):
  matmul_dispatcher_kernelselect  48.9ms
  int8_gemm_swizzle             23.2ms
  kv_cache_write                12.8ms
  attention_rope_apply           7.1ms
  fallback_gemm_generic          5.6ms

note: before v2 matmul_dispatcher was ~31ms and int8_gemm was 10.2ms.
```

alex: my hypothesis: v2 is doing a different kernel choice for models with non-standard kv dim / head layout (mixtral/mistral). Selector falls back to an int8-ish path that triggers extra swizzle. Also the batcher heuristics are exposing longer sequences to a kernel optimized for shorter sequences. Two levers: kernel should inspect (heads, kv_dim, rope_scale) and batcher should maintain bins based on effective RoPE scaling groups.

maria: to add: Mixtral has head_dim=64 but kv_dim rotates differently (permuted layout) vs Llama. When kv_dim % 128 != 0 selector picks generic path. We saw perf cliff at kv_dim % 64 != 0 too. Suggest adding a specialized int8_gemm_perm kernel that supports kv-strided layouts. Also RoPE scaling change (we applied auto-scaling x0.9) can invalidate prefix reuse heuristics & cause more frequent KV writes.

sam: on quant side: AWQ calibration prompts show an accuracy delta vs GPTQ on Qwen/mistral families. Observed: AWQ (default 128 calibration prompts) -> ~1.8% BLEU drop on eval suite for Mistral-7B, whereas GPTQ with per-layer calibration is ~0.6%. That suggests our calibration prompt set and kernel rounding interacts badly with RoPE-rescaling layers. Proposal: per-model calibration presets + preserve FP32 for RoPE-critical layers during quant.

mike: actionable items: 1) perf harness: run matrix (Llama/Mistral/Mixtral/Qwen) x (AWQ/GPTQ/INT8/FP8) x (batcher:{default,seq-binned,aggressive}) on a p4d canary — collect tail p99/p999 + flame graphs. 2) add kv-dim and head-dim checks in kernel-selector before choosing swizzle path. 3) add calibration-prompt suites per family and run quant-accuracy smoke. 4) quick rollback on canary if >10% tail regression.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary rollback scheduled: kernel-selector v1 -> v2 rollback completed on pool dedicated-pool-us-east-1 at 2024-12-18T15:34:32Z.

sara: i'll start the perf harness runs (will push configs to infra/perf-harness with matrix.yml). sam — can you add the AWQ calibration presets for Mistral/Mixtral + a control group that keeps RoPE layers FP32?

sam: yup. i'll prepare calibration presets and add a small eval harness (100 prompts) to measure delta. will also try FP8 fallback only for attention-rope ops.

mike: thanks. let's sync in the morning for results. if anyone finds a quick kernel patch that avoids the swizzle while keeping numeric correctness, ping me and i'll cut a patch release. :thumbsup:
